concept.title: Prepare your XML
concept.shortdesc: CSSMedia generates a PDF from almost any well-formed XML file, provided that you give it an appropriate CSS file.

conbody.p: Some XML projects consist of multiple files that need pre-processing before they are ready for publishing. Projects based on DITA or DocBook need to merge all the files that make up a project into one XML file.

ul.li: If you work with DITA, use TypesDitac to process your topics and generate one combined XML file for CSSMedia.
If you work with DocBook, TypesBook helps you merge your files into a single document ready for CSSMedia.
